name: form-04
title: Form 04
description: A CVV field with digit-length validation.

meta.prompt:
Create a minimal single-field form for cvv, filling available width up to 384px. Stack the “CVV” label, a text input with a numeric keyboard and card-security-code autofill, and a compact primary Submit button with 16px spacing between the field and button. Use neutral theme-aware borders, rounded controls, and visible keyboard focus.

Require exactly three or four digits. Start with an empty value, validate on submission, and show field errors beneath the control with invalid styling and an accessible invalid state. Associate the label with the control. A valid submission stays on the form without a success screen or external action.
